scares.description: in the reflection of the dogs eyes, a figure lunges forward to grab it.
a bloody bandana falls to the ground with a loud splat sound after lot of tension building.
a figure rises in the background
Indy sees a figure run up the stairs at him on all fours.
Indy wakes up and a hand pulls him underneath the bed
A hand reaches from the darkness to grab Indy
a dog food bowl gets thrown at Indy from the darkness.
lightning flashes, revealing a dark figure standing right next to Indy
as Indy sniffs the grass, a shadow hand reaches out of the ground at him
shadow figure appears in front of Indy
